execution.first_with_sanka_gate: target_boot must pass before any remaining with-sanka-readiness-aware cell
execution.mode: foreground rolling coordinator with calibrated provider queues
execution.retry_policy: none; stop and classify infrastructure failures before any separately authorized rerun
execution.turn_budget_policy: Claude --max-turns 120 intended to be non-binding (v4 cap 60 bound Sonnet in 17/22 cells); the turn distribution is published; Codex has no turn cap and is bounded by agent_timeout_seconds; v5 turn counts are not comparable with v4
execution.with_sanka_arm: readiness-aware: the harness runs sanka scan + plan before the agent starts, freezes sanka-readiness.json, injects readiness/unsupported/skipped checklists, scaffold only at >= 50% readiness (runner mode selected by the candidate suffix)
